scope: Read-only bounded executable studio review of exact admitted project runtime frames, using existing Dragon numeric raster checks and temporal segmentation. Existing workspace jobs own authorization, source rights, cancellation, leases and result publication.

interfaces.pure: analyze_frame_sequence(frames, source_identity=None) accepts actual runtime-produced frame projections and measured operation timings; returns quantitative findings with evidence references
interfaces.execute: review_project_sequence(environment_request, actions, seed, capture_every, policy_snapshot, cancel, on_event) executes only canonical registered environment adapters
interfaces.api: POST /api/game-learning/projects/{project_id}/review starts existing scoped review job; GET /api/game-learning/jobs/{job_id} reads canonical completion; GET /api/game-learning/projects/{project_id}/reviews/{job_id} rechecks current source authority; GET /api/game-learning/projects/{project_id}/reviews/{job_id}/export returns exact digest-labelled completed review JSON after the same current-source/policy/baseline checks
interfaces.semantic: analyze_executed_semantics(request, trace, source_identity, native_binding, geometry_snapshot) consumes bounded actual canonical transitions and optional approved native ABI descriptor; no screenshots or callbacks confer application authority
interfaces.compare: compare_executed_reviews(baseline,candidate,mode=same_source) defaults to strict matched current-source/frozen-policy comparison; explicit source_revision additionally requires issued original-successor workload contracts. Pure output grants no caller authority.
interfaces.historical: Existing application _load_review historical=True is an internal completed-job observation/restoration path: exact scoped admitted job, frozen file/input/result digests and live source/teacher/policy/external-origin restrictions. Public review inspect/export retains current-source authority; no arbitrary historical-source endpoint or old-world execution.

measurements: sampled adjacent frame motion and repeated-image evidence
actual simulation and preview operation wall times, separate from presentation FPS
Actual source/entity/tile collision geometry and bounded analytical route candidates
Actual instrumented directional-control response and task event coverage
Source-bound quest/resource feasibility within declared authored interpreter semantics
authority: No caller-uploaded screenshots at the application route, no arbitrary callback or user code, no model credentials/network. Exact frozen source/project epoch/policy digest revalidated before publication and review-specific reads. Numeric findings are advisory candidate constraints, not promotion or deployment authority.
recovery: Existing job fencing rejects stale/cancelled publication. Interrupted read-only reviews may rerun from their frozen initial seed; no user play state or committed training policy is modified.
limitations: No subjective aesthetics or trained language model critic
No OCR, semantic HUD readability or accessibility certification
No display refresh, browser/native presentation FPS, isolated memory measurement or hardware claims from an offline preview
Repeated frames during observed movement are candidates requiring inspection, not proven stutter
Numeric evidence cannot establish original asset rights

paired_review_extension.owner: Existing review modules/routes and existing scoped workspace jobs; no new service, collection, authority or provider
paired_review_extension.request: Optional baseline_review_job_id selects only an actual completed same-project current-authority original unpaired review; its exact review/input digests and original policy identity are frozen before dispatch and rechecked before publication and every review-specific read. Reference-review chains are rejected to bound transitive work.
paired_review_extension.comparison: Default same_source comparison requires exact project/head/epoch, environment request/spec, reviewer implementation, seed, planned steps, capture interval and controller protocol. Different frozen policies remain labelled policy comparisons. Explicit source_revision mode supports only issued matched original-successor workload contracts, with stable action/observation/reward contract, workload/controller protocol, seed and actual reviewer/runtime implementation; intentional source identity drift is retained in separate baseline/candidate bindings. Mismatches or legacy evidence are inconclusive; arbitrary screenshots never become paired execution.
paired_review_extension.protocol: Explicit action digest or registered action-cycle identity is retained, alongside actual planned/observed step counts. Legacy evidence without this protocol remains readable but comparison is inconclusive.
paired_review_extension.triangle: Bounded digest-linked execution, Dragon numerical/source scrutiny and adversarial comparability/regression projections, with prioritized actual findings and explicit follow-up constraints. Deterministic roles are labelled; no model critic, quality certification, promotion, automatic mutation or invented learning score.
paired_review_extension.recovery: Baseline withdrawal, changed digest, current-source failure or missing completion fails closed; no baseline result is copied into a new owner/store. Existing fenced job recovery and physical cancellation apply.

storage: Existing workspace storage admitter reserves at most2MiB output per exact job identity before execution; receipts remain in frozen job input and completion is fenced by the existing owner.

semantic_review.scope: Actual executed control/goal/event measurements with source-bound authored geometry and exact approved native observation metadata; opaque ROM pixels remain advisory and cannot prove player/control/goal semantics.
semantic_review.interfaces: Existing review_project_sequence adds bounded semantic_review and remedial_actions; no additional rollouts beyond admitted step/capture budgets.
semantic_review.geometry_claim: Initial authored snapshot body-aware four-neighbor geometric candidate routes. Conditional gates, timelines, one-way physics, abilities, combat and full progression remain outside an unconditional reachability claim.
semantic_review.proposals: Typed bounded app inspect/edit proposals bind exact source digest, actual entity/tile/counterexample IDs and current manifest/version. Writes are validated pure drafts and always require explicit subsequent scoped execution; review never edits.
semantic_review.evidence: Physical position and collision/control response must come from declared runtime instrumentation; source facts are labelled analytical and measured failures are labelled bounded-run observations, never general game impossibility.

source_revision_quality_extension.owner: Existing canonical numerical review owner/mirror, scoped workspace jobs and application successor/goal owners; no new provider/service/store/promotion authority
source_revision_quality_extension.issuance: review_project_sequence issues the contract only for an actually executed successor request without a frozen Q policy. Bind the environment request excluding only authored tree bytes and the environment action/observation/reward contract excluding only its source-dependent environment digest. Actual source identities and protocol remain separately pinned.
source_revision_quality_extension.controller: Only explicit_actions or registered_action_cycle, with matching seed, planned/capture protocol and explicit action digest; no arbitrary-policy cross-source reuse.
source_revision_quality_extension.implementation: Reviewer implementation digest includes canonical successor runtime/world and environment request/runtime owner files, in addition to existing numerical/render/source dependencies. Material implementation drift makes old/new observations unpaired.
source_revision_quality_extension.measurements: Actual bounded task return and available semantic goal/death/control observations. Frame-count and wall-time changes remain advisory; easier edited objectives do not establish a better game, significance or generalization.
source_revision_quality_extension.quality_gate: Existing opt-in original goal policy may require configured current-source step/frame/finding bounds and no observed paired regression before packaging/export. A model explanation or single observed improvement cannot promote production or certify subjective quality.
source_revision_quality_extension.historical_authority: Only actual completed same-project admitted review jobs with matching frozen file/input/result identities. Preserve live direct/derived source rights, separate external-source project version/input epoch checks, teacher consent and policy snapshot pins. Exact own prepared-editor operation allowance is threaded through the same existing authorities, never an unrelated pending-write bypass.

restoration.owner: backend/core/game_successor.py and backend/routes/game_successor.py; existing world.edit prepared-save owner
restoration.request: restore_review_job_id is a third mutually exclusive alternative to changes or typed edits, alongside current expected_version/spec digest and idempotency key. Existing requests omit absent fields and retain exact admitted request identities.
restoration.authority: Load a genuine completed scoped/admitted original review with live historical authority; immutable non-editable world identity/origins must equal the current saved spec. Caller-supplied historical source trees are not accepted.
restoration.execution: Canonical emitter validates/regenerates the reference spec, including removing optional sections absent in it. The measured-quality host additionally verifies the complete original path/content tree. Project versions and changed-file revisions continue increasing; no historical identity counter rollback.
restoration.control: A quality goal may restore only its exact pinned rejected incumbent under explicit edit/restoration grants, spending existing finite budgets and preserving rejected evidence. Cancellation/expiry stops subsequent restoration work.

source_revision_quality_extension.qualification: Implementation candidate only. Numerical owner evidence is not model critique, automatic model-weight learning, target-OS execution, universal emulation or enterprise-grade qualification.
